arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_fraud_usd FROM transactions t INNER JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Sums the amounts of transactions labelled as fraud and converts the total from cents to dollars.
assumptions: Fraud means fraud_labels.is_fraud = 1; transactions with no label are excluded rather than treated as non-fraud.
Amounts are summed as recorded, including any negative amounts among the fraud-labelled rows.
